name: Patio de ripio y flota
description: YARD with FLEET: bright white-grey gravel (ripio) surface, Patagonian steppe behind, distant flat mesetas, barbed-wire fence with weathered white wooden posts, deep blue sky. White heavy trucks, tank trucks with cylindrical white aluminum tanks, and a white utility truck with red and navy swoosh stripes; door decal with the Clear logo and a fleet number; amber roof beacons; red-diamond flammable-liquid placard with a UN number on tankers. No third-party brand names or logos; trucks stay generic.

name: Locación de pozo
description: WELL SITE: wellhead with red valves and gauges, pumpjack with counterweights, white modular trailers, bright white-grey gravel, Patagonian steppe and flat mesetas behind, deep blue sky.

name: Plataforma de workover
description: WORKOVER PLATFORM: yellow-and-blue steel workover platform with yellow handrails and hanging chains over a wellhead with red valves, bright white-grey gravel around it, pumpjack in the distance, Patagonian steppe and deep blue sky.

name: Oficina contenedor
description: OFFICE CONTAINER: modular prefab container office, cream and light-grey panels, exposed conduit, fluorescent tube, whiteboard with process diagrams, radios in charging cradles, binders on steel shelves, a window with the steppe and pumpjacks, jacket with reflective tape on a hook.
